subject.title: [Bug] web_fetch fails in dual-stack networks when DNS returns IPv6 special-use addresses

question: Should `web_fetch` allow a hostname when at least one resolved address is public and allowed, while filtering blocked DNS answers out of the pinned pool?
rationale: The code change is bounded, but it relaxes default SSRF DNS-answer semantics for a model-callable network tool, so automation should not choose the security policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve Mixed-Answer Filtering
options.body: Filter blocked DNS answers, fail only when every answer is blocked, and require focused SSRF tests for pinned lookup and dispatcher override behavior.

options.title: Keep Strict Any-Blocked Policy
options.body: Preserve the current fail-closed behavior and direct affected deployments toward trusted proxy or fake-IP opt-in configuration where applicable.

options.title: Require Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Keep the default strict policy and solve polluted DNS handling only through a new or existing operator-controlled `web_fetch` SSRF policy surface.

recommendation.title: Approve Mixed-Answer Filtering
recommendation.body: Filter blocked DNS answers, fail only when every answer is blocked, and require focused SSRF tests for pinned lookup and dispatcher override behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on the central SSRF security boundary and related IPv6 special-use behavior.
